text:
viv: noticed large warmup backlog in us-west-2 after the egress baseline went live ~15m ago. 18 nodes stuck in joining.
ovar: allocator error: `keystore: dial tcp 10.240.9.17:443: i/o timeout`
rachel: security pushed deny for 10.240.0.0/16 outbound last night as part of audit-hardening. internal-keystore lives at 10.240.9.17.
viv: nodes need the keystore to unwrap disk CMKs during boot -> they never finish onboarding. this will blow the warm-pool cost if not fixed.
sec-bot: alert: gpu-onboard-keystore-block_usw2 count=18 severity=high
omar: options: 1) temporary scoped egress allow to the keystore IP (fast) 2) route keystore traffic via control-plane egress gateway (compliant, longer)
rachel: security can approve short-lived exceptions but we need audit notes + TTL + owner. prefer allow scoped to SG and single IP.
viv: agree. i'll open a PR and we can get a quick approval. scope to tag=warmpool=true. TTL 30m.
omar: PR created: `infra/hotfix/allow-keystore-usw2` plan snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "tmp_allow_keystore" {
  type = "egress"
  from_port = 443
  to_port = 443
  protocol = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.240.9.17/32"]
  description = "TEMP: allow warmpool -> internal-keystore for disk unwrap (30m)"
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.warmup.id
}
```
deploy-bot: apply started infra/hotfix/allow-keystore-usw2 at 6192837485 by viv
ops-bot: canary: 3/3 warmed at 6192837498
omar: rolling to 20 nodes. set ALLOC_LOG_LEVEL=debug for canary nodes to capture TLS handshake.
rachel: audit note recorded: temporary egress exception approved (viv/omar/rachel). TTL 30m. follow-ups: 1) infra#5230 implement keystore egress via control-plane gateway 2) security to publish exception runbook 3) add e2e decrypt test.
ops-bot: warm-pool back to healthy state at 6192837512.
deploy-bot: destroy infra/hotfix/allow-keystore-usw2 completed at 6192837518 by viv
viv: postmortem summary: root cause = egress baseline accidentally included keystore subnet. mitigation = timeboxed scoped allow. action items assigned on infra#5230. closing alert. :thumbsup:
